appendix_4_contributing_date_semantics_c.added_before: J1 Batch 1 production (append-only clarification, NOT an erratum; discovered while implementing the production machinery)
appendix_4_contributing_date_semantics_c.issue: protocol body defines a contributing date as 'an admitted date where BOTH cells of an arm have >=1 built case' — but the ETF expansion count is a market-level function of T (identical for every case on the same date; this was also true in discovery, where each arm's two sides are disjoint date sets). The literal wording is therefore unsatisfiable.
appendix_4_contributing_date_semantics_c.clarified_semantics: per arm, per side (cell value): a contributing date is an admitted date whose frozen expansion count EQUALS that side's cell AND on which >=1 case was built. The arm coverage gate is unchanged and inherited from R4: >=5 distinct contributing dates for EACH side of the arm.
appendix_4_contributing_date_semantics_c.impact: none on gates, thresholds, hypotheses, verdict table, or blindness — this matches how discovery's R4(d) was computed (dates_A / dates_B are per-side date counts).
